title: 대법관후보추천위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Exclusion of Members)
(1) A member shall not participate in the examination or resolution of an agenda item where the member or a relative of the member is a party to the matter, or where there is another substantial ground making it impossible to ensure impartiality in the examination or resolution.
(2) Where the Recommendation Committee finds that a ground for exclusion under paragraph (1) exists, it shall make a decision on exclusion by resolution.
